tools.description: Structural code search and refactoring tool using AST pattern matching
tools.usage: ast-grep --pattern 'console.log($$$)' # Find console.log statements\nast-grep --pattern 'function $NAME($$$) { $$$ }' --rewrite 'const $NAME = ($$$) => { $$$ }' # Convert to arrow functions\nast-grep -l typescript --pattern 'interface $NAME { $$$ }' # Find TypeScript interfaces
